entities.summary: The Russian Museum of Ethnography is a museum in St. Petersburg that houses a collection of about 500,000 items relating to the ethnography, or cultural anthropology, of peoples of the former Russian Empire and the Soviet Union. Russian Museum of Ethnography is a museum in Europe, established in 1902. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
